name: photocraft
description: Unofficial: lets Claude operate PhotoCraft, the open-source Photoshop-style photo editor: the live app on macOS, or headless in Claude app chats (web, desktop, iPhone, iPad) and on Linux. Batch editing and professional retouching workflows: skin, eyes and teeth, colour grading, cutouts and product photos, object and wire removal, straightening, skies and photo restoration.
